apps.name: PoopPal
apps.subtitle: Retro 16-bit Social Poop Tracker
apps.localizedDescription: PoopPal is a retro 16-bit pixel buddy social poop counter with paired friend sync and home-screen companion widget. Track daily habits, share milestones with your partner or squad, and keep healthy with zero spam.

versions.localizedDescription: v1.1.0: Real-time paired friend synchronization, eliminated launch auth screen flash, iOS safe area layout enhancements, and AltStore sideloading support.
Initial iOS Release with AltStore Classic sideloading support, real-time Firebase pairing, and retro audio/haptics.

news.title: PoopPal v1.1.0 is Live!
